title: MissionControl
description: Use controllers from other consoles via Bluetooth.
author: ndeadly
details:
Use controllers from other consoles natively via Bluetooth. No dongles or other external hardware necessary.

After installing this package, reboot your console to activate the module.

MissionControl supports a wide range of Bluetooth controllers, including Wii/Wii U, DualShock 3/4, DualSense, Xbox One Bluetooth controllers, several 8BitDo models, and many third-party controllers. It integrates with the Switch's native controller pairing and remapping interfaces, supports rumble and motion controls on compatible devices, and can connect multiple non-Switch Bluetooth controllers simultaneously.
changelog:
v0.16.1

This release adds support for firmware 23.5.0, an option to disable the button combos for Home and Capture, along with some bugfixes. See below for full changelog. New users landing on this release page should first check out the readme on the [main project page](https://github.com/ndeadly/MissionControl#readme) for the official project documentation. There you can find installation and usage instructions along with an FAQ section that will answer most of your questions. ### Changelog - Added full support for firmware 23.5.0 - Added config option to missioncontrol.ini for disabling Home and Capture button combos - Fixed timestamp units for dscale motion format (thanks @Steklorez) - Fixed incorrect offsets in bluetooth exefs patches for firmwares 22.0.0+
